main.description: Get information about the authenticated aggregator's API key. Note: The actual key value is NEVER returned - only metadata about the key.

parameters.description: No parameters required. Returns key info for the authenticated aggregator.

hasKey.description: Whether the aggregator has an API key (active or revoked)

keyInfo.description: API key metadata. Only present if hasKey is true.

errors.description: Authentication is required to get API key info
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

errors.description: Only registered aggregators can get API key info
errors.name: AggregatorRequired
